descriptor_width_audit.safe_claim: The descriptor payload is exactly 53 bits. This is not a complete interface, producer-state, or bandwidth-cost figure.

ready_error_dependency_audit.risk_boundary: The core settles without an internal ready/error loop, but group_ready depends on descriptor payload even when group_valid=0. An external producer must hold a defined payload and must not derive valid or payload from ready, or a registered/skid wrapper should make that protocol explicit.

P1.title: Full canonical row-fold correctness is not closed inside M128
P1.evidence: The independent VCS test accepted one unsorted distinct-ID descriptor, one holey-valid descriptor, and the same source ID in two descriptors of the same row. M128 audits only descriptor-local duplication, padding, mask, cache and block identity. It does not create canonical descriptors or conserve sources across a row.
P1.required_fix: Implement and exact-SHA verify the external descriptor producer, including sorted/left-packed K1-K4 formation and per-row exactly-once source conservation, or explicitly narrow all M128 claims to trusted descriptor-local arithmetic and transport.

P1.title: row_done has ambiguous ownership during cross-row II1
P1.evidence: row_done is registered from the prior accepted update_last, while update outputs can already carry the next row. The independent run observed 134 cycles in which row_done for the previous row overlapped a valid update for a different next row, and row_done has no row/block tag.
P1.required_fix: Define row completion by the accepted update_last handshake, or add an explicit delayed done block/row tag and reverify cross-row II1 consumers under stalls. Do not associate an untagged row_done pulse with the concurrently visible update_row.

P2.title: group_ready is descriptor-payload-semantic even when valid is low
P2.finding: Two probes confirmed legal payload makes group_ready high and invalid mask makes it low while group_valid=0. The RTL has no internal combinational loop, but the interface is not payload-independent decoupled ready.
P2.required_fix: Document the producer stability/no-ready-dependence rule or place a registered/skid boundary before using this interface in a larger ready-valid graph.

P2.title: The 53-bit value is payload width, not complete traffic cost
P2.finding: 3+9+4+16+4+16+1 is exactly 53 payload bits, excluding valid/ready, any framing or queue metadata, producer state and the cost of transporting descriptors. No baseline-equivalent bandwidth comparison is present.
P2.required_fix: Retain descriptor_payload_bits=53 and keep descriptor_bandwidth_accounted=false until a complete matched source-format and traffic ledger exists.

P2.title: External predecode hardware and cost are absent
P2.finding: The claimed critical-path repair moves canonical grouping outside this RTL. Neither the descriptor producer nor its latency, area, power, buffering and bandwidth is modeled, so it cannot be described as free or as a net physical improvement.
P2.required_fix: Build or model the producer in the matched design boundary before admitting frequency, PPA or net accelerator advantage.

P2.title: No physical or system performance admission exists
P2.finding: The evidence is commercial RTL simulation only. The 1,536-byte four-read cache is behavioral; there is no matched DC/frequency result, foundry macro implementation, power, cycle-simulator integration or system metric.
P2.required_fix: Keep DC frequency improvement, macro PPA, physical speedup, system speedup and headline false until separately measured and independently admitted.

paper_safe_statement: Exact-SHA Synopsys VCS and an independent adversarial test verify M128 descriptor-local signed K1-K4 arithmetic over 13,344 independent lane checks, fail-closed malformed descriptors, a 97-cycle ready-valid stall with same-cycle retire/replace, reset isolation, and 127 consecutive cross-row descriptor/update II1 intervals. The descriptor payload is 53 bits. Canonical descriptor production, valid left-packing, cross-descriptor per-row source conservation, descriptor traffic/cost, unambiguous tagged row completion, matched DC frequency, macro PPA, physical speedup and system speedup remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim full row-fold or exactly-once source conservation from M128 alone.
Do not call external canonical descriptor generation free or implemented.
Do not call 53 bits complete interface, producer, or bandwidth cost.
Do not associate untagged row_done with the concurrently visible update_row during cross-row II1.
Do not claim frequency, area, power, macro, physical, system, FPS, energy, or headline speedup from VCS.
